examples: Is Wi-Fi facility available at the airport?
Can I get internet access at the airport?

responses: The airport is Wi-Fi enabled and passengers can enjoy **free Wi-Fi** while they are at the airport. A free Wi-Fi link **!!Free_CAAN_WorldLink_WI-Fi!!** is available to connect with internet facility.

examples: Where do I contact for any query and flight information at the airport?
Who can I ask for flight information?

Which desks provide information about flights?
responses: You can contact the **TIA help desk** or **Police information desk** at the canopy area, **Information desk** at the check-in area, **help desk** at the departure area, **TIA information desk** or **immigration help desk** at the arrival area, **Customs help desk** at the customs area, **Nepal Airlines help desk**, and **Tourist police information center** for query or any information about your flight at the airport.

examples: Is wheelchair assistance available?
Can I get help with a wheelchair?

How to arrange for wheelchair services?
responses: Yes, **Wheelchairs are available** at the airport. Please contact your **airline** for further support. You may also contact the **help desk** for assistance.

examples: Is there any business lounge facility at the airport?
Are there any business lounges for passengers?
Which hotels operate business lounges?
Where is the business lounge located?
responses: Yes. This facility is available at the **departure area** after immigration and before the final security check in the international terminal. It is being operated by **Hotel Soaltee** and **Hotel Radisson** separately for travelling passengers.

examples: Is there any Child Care lounge facility at the airport?
Is a baby feeding room available at the airport?
Where can I nurse my infant?
Child Care Lounge location
responses: For the privacy of mothers who wish to nurse their infants, a **Child Care Lounge (baby feeding room)** with a baby cot is available at the international and domestic departure lounge.

examples: Does the airport have CIP Room facility?
Can Commercially Important Persons use a special room?
What is the CIP Room for?
How to access the CIP Room?
responses: Yes. This is available for **Commercially Important Person (CIP)** who on arrival may wish to rest while someone takes care of their formalities (i.e., customs, immigration, and luggage collection). You can avail this room as per the guideline of the office.

examples: Does the airport have a money exchange facility?
Are there ATMs and money exchange counters?
Where can I exchange currency at the airport?
Money exchange counter location
responses: Yes. **Two money exchange counters and ATM** are available at the arrival before immigration. An ATM is also available at the public place before entering the international departure terminal of the airport.

examples: Can I use a Credit card at the Airport?
Which credit cards are accepted by shops at the airport?
Can I pay with Visa or Master Card?
Are American Express Cards accepted?
responses: All shops at the airport accept **Master Card, Visa Cards, and American Express Card**.

examples: Is there any accommodation facility in and around the airport?
Can I find a hotel near the airport?
Are there lodging options inside the airport?
How far are hotels from the terminal?
responses: Accommodation facility **within the airport is not available**. However, **Hotel facilities** are available at 4 minutes walking distance from the airport terminal. Other hotels are available in the downtown city located four kilometers away. Please check the website and book directly with the hotels.

examples: Is there any waiting room facility at the airport?
Where is the passenger waiting room?
How long before my flight can I access the waiting room?
Waiting room rules
responses: Passengers holding a valid ticket to travel within the next **12 hours** can access the **waiting room** at the international terminal **Gate A1 side**. Passenger entry may be restricted without prior notice due to security or operational reasons.

examples: Does the airport have a weighing facility before check-in?
Where can I weigh my baggage before check-in?
Is there a baggage weighing scale available?
Weighing facility location
responses: Yes, **weighing facility is available** at the airport before entering the check-in area. You may contact the help desk/information desk for further query.

examples: Does the airport have a baggage wrapping facility in the check-in area?
Where can I get my luggage wrapped?
Baggage wrapping service location
Is bag wrapping available at the international terminal?
responses: Yes, you can get this facility in the **international terminal check-in area B side**.

examples: Does the Airport have smoking areas?
Are there designated areas for smoking?
Where is the smoking lounge?
Rules for smoking at the airport
responses: We have designated **smoking areas** in the **departure lounge of the international terminal** building. Smoking is prohibited at all public places as per Government prevailing law.

examples: Does the airport have any medical facility?
Is there a doctor or nurse at the airport?
Medical emergency services availability
Which hospital runs the airport medical center?
responses: In the event of a medical emergency, well-trained **doctors and nurses** are available from the airport medical center run by **Kathmandu Medical College (KMC) and HAMS Hospital**. They are available **round the clock** till the operation of the airport and are equipped with emergency treatment centers. **Ambulances** are provided for severe medical emergencies. This facility is available at both domestic and international terminals.

examples: Does Airport have a post office?
Where is the Post office located at the airport?
Can I mail something from the airport?
Location of post office
responses: Yes, the **Post office** is located in the **international terminal check-in area B side**.

examples: Do I need to pay to use baggage trolley?
Are baggage trolleys free?
Is there a charge for baggage carts?
Cost of using a trolley
responses: No, you can use a baggage trolley **free of cost**.

examples: Do I need to pay the porters for their assistance while using a baggage trolley at the airport?
Are the trolley collectors free to assist me?
Porters for baggage assistance cost
Can I get help with my trolley for free?
responses: They are actually **trolley collectors**, not porters. However, they can assist you in special cases **free of cost**.

examples: Is left luggage facility available at the airport?
Can I store my luggage at the airport terminal?
Luggage storage facility available?
Does the airport offer bag storage?
responses: No, the **left luggage facility is not available** at the terminal of the airport.

examples: What are the facilities available for passengers with special needs?
Is there priority queue for elderly or disabled passengers?

Assistance for physically challenged persons
responses: Kathmandu Airport offers **barrier-free access** for passengers with special needs. There are arrangements for a separate **priority queue** for elderly people, parents with infants, pregnant women, and physically challenged persons. For assistance, you are requested to contact your respective **airlines in advance**. You may contact the help desk or information desk for further query.

examples: Are friends and relatives allowed at the airport premises?

responses: Normally, it is **discouraged to see-off a passenger** due to space constraints. If required, a **maximum of 3 people** are allowed to see off in the international terminal. A public notice has been published regarding the same.

examples: Where can I welcome my relative, friend or guest coming from abroad?
Where is the international arrival area for greetings?
Place to pick up guests from abroad
International arrival welcome area location
responses: You can welcome your relative, friend, or guest from the **new arrival area of the international terminal**.

Do pregnant women need a 'Fit to Fly' certificate?
Is it safe for pregnant women to fly?
responses: In most cases, it is safe for women with a normal pregnancy to travel by air. However, it is best to check with the **doctor and airline** before planning the travel. In some cases, pregnant women would require to produce a **“Fit to Fly” certificate**.

examples: Can I carry medicines on board?

Rules for carrying medicines in hand baggage

responses: You are required to carry a **doctor's prescription** for medicines that are to be carried on board. Passengers are advised to get in touch with their respective airlines regarding this issue.

responses: Parents of unaccompanied minors need to contact respective **airlines** for the handover procedure before check-in.

responses: Kindly contact the **airline you have flown** and register a **complaint with them before leaving the baggage claim area**. It is the airline's responsibility to assist in such a matter.

Baggage weight restrictions
Baggage size guidelines
responses: Each airline has a definite guideline with regards to baggage. Kindly contact your **airline** for all questions related to carry-on and/or checked baggage before the date of the flight.

examples: Can I carry liquid bottles in my hand baggage?

Allowed Liquids, Aerosols, and Gels (LAGs) limit
Maximum capacity for liquids in carry-on
responses: Passengers can carry Liquids, Aerosols, and Gels (**LAGs**) in containers with a capacity of **not more than 100 ml**. LAGs in a container larger than 100 ml will not be accepted at the security screening checkpoints, even if the container is partially filled.

examples: Can a passenger travelling on International flight carry valuable goods in their check-in luggage?
Is it allowed to put valuables like gold in checked luggage?

Valuable goods in hand baggage rules
responses: No, passengers are **not allowed to carry valuable goods** (e.g., ornaments, gold, silver, money, etc.) in their **checked-in baggage/luggage**. However, they can carry it in **hand baggage** with the prior approval from customs and declaration from the passenger at the airline checking counter during ticket checking.

* Drugs, Narcotics, and other intoxicating agents.

* **Power bank**.
* Dangerous goods.
* Counterfeit (Forgery) currency.
* Radioactive materials.
* Compressed gas, acid, and Mercury.
* Chemical and Biomaterials.

* Antiques
* Other items which are restricted to carry as per Government Rule.

responses: Yes, you are free to use your own mobility equipment. For this, you need to **confirm with your airline** whether your device can be used in the aircraft cabin or must be stored in the hold.

responses: You can carry **laptops, tablets, kindles, and mobiles in your hand baggage**, but you will be asked to put them **separately through the X-Ray machine** while passing the security channel.

Rules for bringing phone chargers on the plane
responses: Yes, **wired chargers are allowed in hand luggage**.

They can request the security person of their problem and can be checked manually. It is also advised the passenger with a Pace Maker not to pass through WTMD.

Support for physically challenged travelers
responses: Yes. But **inform your airline/travel agent** of your requirement at the time of booking and remind them at least **48 hours before** you travel.

Rules for buying liquor at the airport and carrying it on the plane

responses: Passenger can buy Liquor from **duty paid shops** available at the airport and carry them, but according to the **guidelines of the countries**.

responses: It **depends on the specific requirements of the countries** you are travelling.

responses: Each **airline has its own guideline** to carry a pet. Passengers who wish to carry a pet are advised to contact their respective airline or ticket booking agent before the date of the flight with all possible questions related to carrying a pet along with their trip.

Vehicles left unattended at the international terminal will be in police custody and fined.

examples: What are the details of vehicles parking at the Tribhuvan International Airport?

responses: **Paid parking facilities are available** at the airport. Private cars and taxis can be parked at the Car Park located at the **new arrival area of the international terminal**. It can also be parked at the Car Park located in front of the operations/airlines building and domestic terminal. Private vehicles coming to pick up guests are given a stay time of the **first 5 minutes free**, thereafter will be charged as per the rules. However, VIPs and Diplomatic vehicles are advised to park in the parking lot in front of the international terminal.

responses: Tribhuvan International Airport is very well connected with the City. Passengers can reach the airport through **taxi, private car, and city bus**.

The shuttle bus will arrive in every **20 minutes**. Kindly ask the security person in that area for help. For further assistance, you can visit https://www.tiairport.com.np/

What are the terminals at TIA?
responses:
Tribhuvan International Airport has the following terminals:
* **International Terminal** (Departure and Arrival)
* **Domestic Terminal** (Departure and Arrival)
* **Cargo Terminal**

examples: How soon can a passenger enter the International terminal?
When can I enter the international terminal before my flight?
Check-in commencement time before departure
Entry rules for international terminal
responses: On the date of travel, a passenger can enter the terminal anytime. But due to the congestion of the terminal, normally **3 hours before the flight**. The check-in commencement time is usually 3 hours prior to departure and the ticket checking counters close at least one hour prior to departure.

examples: What are the arrangements at the terminal?
How many gates are available for entry into the check-in area?
Number of boarding gates at the international terminal
Check-in counter and immigration desk details at International Terminal
responses:
For passenger convenience, the following arrangements have been made at the International Terminal:

**For the entry into the check-in area:**
* Four gates (**A1, A2, B1, and B2**) are available at the canopy area of the terminal to enter passengers into the check-in area. You need to show your ticket and passport to the security personnel.

**At the Check-in area:**
* Ticket check-in counters are available in two parts: **A-side (A01 to A13)** and **B-side (B01 to B21)**. The counter allocation is dynamic (CUTE system), so check the airline counter signage. A fixed **self-check-in kiosk machine** is available for passenger ease in B-side (initially only for Malaysian airlines).

**At the departure immigration:**
* A total of **14 immigration desks**, including one for VIP/Diplomatic, official, and needy passengers, are available. Queue managers ensure proper alignment and social distancing.

**At the Boarding Gate:**
* **Seven Boarding gates** are available. Passengers are recommended to sit according to their boarding gate number mentioned on the boarding pass and closely monitor public announcements.

examples: How can I get “On Arrival” Visa?
Steps to acquire a Visa On Arrival in Nepal
Do I need to fill out an online 'Tourist Visa' form before arriving?
Process for Nepal Visa On Arrival
responses:
You can follow these steps to acquire a Visa On Arrival:

**Step 1:**
* Get your **arrival card** ready and fill out all details accurately.
* Fill out the online **‘Tourist Visa’ form** (either prior to arrival on the official Department of Immigration website or by using Kiosk machines upon arrival). Print the submission receipt with the barcode. It is valid for fifteen days.

**Step 2:**
* **Make payment** at the bank according to your visa requirement (15/30/90 Days).
* Get the receipt.
* Proceed to the appropriate immigration desk and hand in your documents to an immigration officer.

For more information, visit: https://www.immigration.gov.np/page/visa-on-arrival

examples: What are the different kinds of “On Arrival Visa”?
What type of visa is the On Arrival Visa?
Can I get a Business Visa On Arrival?
How to change my visa status if traveling for non-tourism purposes?
responses: All 'On Arrival Visas' are **Tourist Visas**. Tourist Visas are Entry Visas. If you are traveling to Nepal for purposes other than tourism, you will have to change your visa status by contacting the Department of Immigration with the necessary documents.

examples: I am travelling to Nepal for a business meeting. What kind of visa should I get to enter Nepal?
Visa required for a business trip to Nepal
Can I get a Tourist visa for a business meeting?
How to apply for a Business Visa for Nepal
responses: You have to get a **Tourist visa as an entry visa**. You can get it either from Nepalese diplomatic missions abroad or **On Arrival** (if eligible). If you are investing and running a business in Nepal for the long term, you might consider getting a Business Visa.

examples: I need Tourist Visa with Multiple Re-entry facility. What can I do?
Does the Nepal Tourist Visa have a multiple re-entry facility?
Can I get a multiple re-entry visa on arrival?
Re-entry facility on Nepal visa
responses: All Tourists Visas issued by Nepalese diplomatic missions and 'On Arrival' at the Entry & Exit points (including the Immigration office, Tribhuvan International Airport) bear **multiple Re-entry facility**.

examples: I have children of 5 years and 6 years. Does he/she need a Visa?
Do minors under 10 years need a visa for Nepal?
Is the visa free for children below 10?
Gratis visa for minors
responses: Yes, however, they get it for free. **Minors below 10 years get Gratis visa**.

examples: What is Gratis Visa?
Definition of Gratis Visa
Is the Gratis visa free of cost?
What does 'Gratis' mean in the context of a visa?
responses: It is a kind of Visa that is issued **for free**.

responses: You need to show a document that exclusively proves your nationality. Hence, you need to produce either a **valid Indian Passport or Election Card** (issued by the Election Commission) to enter into Nepal. **Aadhar card or Driving license will not be accepted** as a travel document.

However, in case of emergency, the immigration person may ask for a **Birth Certificate issued from the Indian Government**. For further details, please login to the website: https://tia.immigration.gov.np

examples: I am an NRN card holder. How many days Gratis visa do I get?
Gratis visa duration for Non-Resident Nepali (NRN) card holders
How long is the free visa for NRNs?
NRN visa rules
responses: Gratis visa to an NRN (Non-Resident Nepali) is issued for **30 days** at the moment. It is subject to change as per the directive issued by the Department of Immigration and the Ministry of Home Affairs.

examples: I do not want to wait in queue for visa at the Tribhuvan International Airport? What can I do?

Pre-Arrival Visa option
responses: You can get a **Pre-Arrival Visa** to Nepal from Nepalese diplomatic missions abroad.

Visa queue duration during peak season
responses: Usually, you can get visas in **less than an hour**. Nevertheless, you can expect some delays and queues, especially during the peak tourist season.

examples: What currency is accepted for payment of required visa fees?

responses: It is better to carry **American dollars (in cash)** for payment, even though other currencies are accepted too.

responses: Yes. But you are advised to carry **cash (American dollars)** as well, at least to cover your Visa expenses.

examples: I have obtained visa from Nepalese Embassy in London (United Kingdom). When should I enter Nepal?
Visa validity period after issuance by Nepalese Embassy
Time limit for entering Nepal after receiving a pre-arrival visa

responses: You should come to Nepal **within 6 months** (from the visa issued date).

examples: I am Nepali passport holder. I am travelling abroad. What should I do?
Documents required for Nepali citizens traveling abroad
Visa on Arrival option for Nepali passport holders
Nepali citizen travel requirements
responses: Nepalese citizens travelling abroad require a **valid Nepali passport and visa** for the destination country, except in case of countries where “Visa on Arrival” is available.

examples: I am Nepali passport holder. I am travelling to India. What should I do?
Documents required for Nepali citizens traveling to India
Can a Nepali citizen use a Citizenship Certificate to enter India?

responses: Nepali citizens must produce a **valid Passport or Nepali citizenship certificate or Election Card** (issued by the Election Commission) to enter India. If traveling with an infant (24 months), you may be asked for a birth certificate, and if traveling with a kid below 16 years, you may be asked for either a valid school ID with a birth date or a valid minor identity card from the Nepal Government.

examples: I am Nepalese. I am travelling for foreign employment. What should I do for immigration clearance?
Documents required for Nepali foreign employment travelers at immigration
Is a labor permit required for Nepalese foreign workers?
Immigration check requirements for Nepali foreign employees
responses:
You must present the following documents to an immigration officer in the departure desks:
* **Valid passport and Visa**.
* **Boarding pass** to the final destination.
* **Labor permit** issued by the Government of Nepal.
* Other documents as appropriate and requested.
After immigration checks, proceed to security checks. Make sure your departure is certified in your boarding pass and travel document (Passport).

examples: I am Nepalese. I am travelling abroad for tourism and /or Visit. What should I do for immigration clearance?
Immigration requirements for Nepali citizens on a Tourist/Visit Visa
Is cash currency required for Nepalese traveling abroad for tourism?

responses:
Nepalese citizens travelling on a Tourist/Visit Visa shall produce the following documents at the departure desk of immigration:
* **Valid passport and Visa** clarifying the purpose of travel.
* **Two-way air-ticket**.
* **Hotel booking**.
* A letter exhibiting details of the **sponsor** (individual or institution).
* **500 US dollars (cash/dollar or equivalent foreign currency) and authorized stamp/seal of the related bank** is required.
* Other documents as appropriate and requested.
If you are traveling to visit your spouse working in Gulf countries, you must produce a recommendation letter issued by the concerned Nepalese Embassy verifying your invitation. Valid Nepali passport and visa are required for the destination country, except where "Visa on Arrival" is available.

examples: I am Nepalese. I am travelling abroad for institutional purpose. What should I do for immigration clearance?

responses:
The Nepali Citizens traveling abroad for Institutional purposes (e.g., Seminars, Exhibitions, Knowledge and Skill exchange programs, etc.) shall produce the following documents at the departure desk of immigration:
* **Passport valid at least for 6 months**.
* **VISA of the inviting country**.
* **Invitation letter and program details** explaining the purpose of the visit.
* **Two-way air ticket**.
* A document clarifying the **institutional association**.
* Other documents as appropriate and requested.

examples: Can I bring a television from abroad?

Duty-free TV size limit for non-social security fund members

responses: Nepali citizens in foreign employment and residing abroad for at least 12 months with prior approval from the labor ministry and connected with the government’s social security fund can bring **any type and size of television**. Those not connected can bring only up to **32 inches television without paying customs duty**. Others returning from training/seminar and residing abroad for less than 12 months can bring a television with customs duty. For more information, visit https://customs.gov.np/

examples: How many mobile phones can I carry to Nepal?

responses: Normally, you are allowed to carry **only one mobile phone** for your personal use. Nepali citizens in foreign employment and residing abroad for at least 6 months with prior approval from the labor ministry can bring **one extra mobile phone without paying customs duty**. You may be asked to complete customs process for the extra phone. For more information, visit https://customs.gov.np/

examples: Can I allowed to bring gold jewelry items?

Maximum allowed weight for gold jewelry with customs duty
Customs rules for bringing gold jewelry
responses: Normally, it is allowed to bring **50 grams of gold jewelry for female and 25 grams for male without paying customs duty**. On top of this, you are allowed to bring up to **100 grams with customs duty** and another **100 grams with extra 3% charges** on the applicable customs duty. Gold jewelry more than 225 grams for male and 250 grams for female are **not allowed** in any case and will be seized. *Note: Beruwa rings, Bangles, chain like jewelry made from 24 carat gold (free from alloy) which looks like ornaments will not be considered as ornaments.* For more information, visit https://customs.gov.np/

examples: What is the customs limit for gold?

responses: You are allowed to bring **100 grams of gold (24 carat gold, not jewelry) with customs duty**.

examples: How much liquor is allowed as duty free while travelling to Nepal?
